title: list_by_chat and list_by_chat_paged duplicate attachment batch-load logic
description: message.rs: list_by_chat (lines 219-254) and list_by_chat_paged (lines 295-328) contain identical 35-line blocks for batch-loading attachments. The SQL query, the att_map HashMap build, and the message-to-attachment merge loop are copied verbatim. The only structural difference between the two functions is the SQL has OFFSET ?3. A future fix to the attachment batch query (e.g. adding a column, fixing the ORDER BY, or changing the placeholder logic) must be made in both places. Extract the batch-load into a private fn load_attachments_for_messages(conn, messages) -> Result<(), KithError> that both callers use.
